introCutscene.text: A violent protest photo is spreading across social media. Caption: 'Veritas residents clash with police.'
But something feels off. The buildings don't match. The shadows point the wrong way.
Trace the image origin. Check the lighting. Verify the location. Is this really Veritas?

conclusionText: The photo was taken in a different city — 2,000km away — during an unrelated protest. The lighting angles and a misidentified building gave it away. Always reverse-image-search before sharing.
